description_en: Resets the password of the root account in an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 重置MongoDB实例中数据库账号的密码
kebab_example: aliyun dds reset-account-password --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --account-name root --account-password 'Ali!123456' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetAccountPassword

parameters.help_en: The account whose password needs to be reset. Set the value to root
parameters.help_zh: 需要重置密码的账号，取值：root
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The new password.

The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include `! # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
重置后的密码，即修改后的密码。

密码由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成，特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
密码长度为8-32位。

特殊字符的处理方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The role of the instance.

If the instance is a sharded cluster instance, this parameter is required. Valid values: db and cs.

If the instance is a replica set instance, you can leave this parameter empty or set the parameter to normal
parameters.help_zh:
实例的角色类型，取值说明


当实例类型为分片集群时，charactertype为必选； 取值为db 和cs。
当实例类型为副本集时，charactertype 可为空或传入normal
parameters.name: character_type
